(define-constant REWARD_SCALE u10000000000)
(define-constant DENOMINATOR-BPS u10000)
(define-constant SBTC-TOKEN 'SM3VDXK3WZZSA84XXFKAFAF15NNZX32CTSG82JFQ4.sbtc-token)
(define-constant TRACKER .ststxbtc-tracking-v2)

(define-constant ERR_NOT_INITIALIZED (err u40001))
(define-constant ERR_ALREADY_INITIALIZED (err u40002))
(define-constant ERR_NOTHING_TO_SWEEP (err u40003))
(define-constant ERR_BPS_TOO_HIGH (err u40005))
(define-constant ERR_NOT_KEEPER (err u40006))
(define-constant ERR_SPAN_OVER_AVAILABLE (err u40007))
(define-constant ERR_SWEEP_TOO_SOON (err u40008))
(define-constant ERR_BUDGET_EXCEEDED (err u40009))

(define-data-var initialized bool false)
(define-data-var cumm-at-last-sweep uint u0)
(define-data-var max-capture-bps uint u2000)
(define-data-var keeper principal tx-sender)
(define-data-var last-sweep-burn uint u0)
(define-data-var total-recycled uint u0)
(define-data-var max-total-recycled uint u0)
(define-data-var min-sweep-interval uint u36)
(define-read-only (get-initialized)
  (var-get initialized)
)

(define-read-only (get-cumm-at-last-sweep)
  (var-get cumm-at-last-sweep)
)

(define-read-only (get-max-capture-bps)
  (var-get max-capture-bps)
)

(define-read-only (get-keeper)
  (var-get keeper)
)

(define-read-only (get-last-sweep-burn)
  (var-get last-sweep-burn)
)

(define-read-only (get-total-recycled)
  (var-get total-recycled)
)

(define-read-only (get-max-total-recycled)
  (var-get max-total-recycled)
)

(define-read-only (get-min-sweep-interval)
  (var-get min-sweep-interval)
)

(define-read-only (get-pot-balance)
  (unwrap-panic (contract-call? 'SM3VDXK3WZZSA84XXFKAFAF15NNZX32CTSG82JFQ4.sbtc-token get-balance .ststxbtc-tracking-v2))
)

(define-public (sweep
    (claimed-withheld uint)
    (span-consumed uint)
  )
  (let (
    (cumm (contract-call? .ststxbtc-tracking-data-v2 get-cumm-reward))
    (available-span (- cumm (var-get cumm-at-last-sweep)))
    (pot (get-pot-balance))
    (cap (/ (* pot (var-get max-capture-bps)) DENOMINATOR-BPS))
    (amount (if (< claimed-withheld cap) claimed-withheld cap))
    (span-settled (/ (* span-consumed amount) claimed-withheld))
  )
    (asserts! (is-eq tx-sender (var-get keeper)) ERR_NOT_KEEPER)
    (asserts! (var-get initialized) ERR_NOT_INITIALIZED)
    (asserts! (>= (- burn-block-height (var-get last-sweep-burn)) (var-get min-sweep-interval))
      ERR_SWEEP_TOO_SOON)
    (asserts! (<= (+ (var-get total-recycled) amount) (var-get max-total-recycled))
      ERR_BUDGET_EXCEEDED)
    (asserts! (> span-consumed u0) ERR_NOTHING_TO_SWEEP)
    (asserts! (<= span-consumed available-span) ERR_SPAN_OVER_AVAILABLE)
    (asserts! (> claimed-withheld u0) ERR_NOTHING_TO_SWEEP)
    (asserts! (> amount u0) ERR_NOTHING_TO_SWEEP)

    (try! (contract-call? TRACKER withdraw-tokens current-contract amount))
    (try! (as-contract?
      ((with-ft 'SM3VDXK3WZZSA84XXFKAFAF15NNZX32CTSG82JFQ4.sbtc-token "sbtc-token" amount))
      (try! (contract-call? TRACKER add-rewards amount))))

    (var-set cumm-at-last-sweep (+ (var-get cumm-at-last-sweep) span-settled))
    (var-set last-sweep-burn burn-block-height)
    (var-set total-recycled (+ (var-get total-recycled) amount))

    (print {
      event: "sweep",
      claimed: claimed-withheld,
      span: span-consumed,
      span-settled: span-settled,
      swept: amount,
      cap: cap,
      pot-before: pot,
      block-height: stacks-block-height
    })
    (ok amount)
  )
)

(define-public (initialize)
  (begin
    (try! (contract-call? .dao check-is-protocol contract-caller))
    (asserts! (not (var-get initialized)) ERR_ALREADY_INITIALIZED)

    (var-set cumm-at-last-sweep (contract-call? .ststxbtc-tracking-data-v2 get-cumm-reward))
    (var-set initialized true)
    (print { event: "initialize", data: { cumm: (var-get cumm-at-last-sweep), block-height: stacks-block-height } })
    (ok true)
  )
)

(define-public (set-max-capture-bps (bps uint))
  (begin
    (try! (contract-call? .dao check-is-protocol contract-caller))
    (asserts! (<= bps DENOMINATOR-BPS) ERR_BPS_TOO_HIGH)

    (var-set max-capture-bps bps)
    (print { event: "set-max-capture-bps", data: { bps: bps, block-height: stacks-block-height } })
    (ok true)
  )
)

(define-public (set-max-total-recycled (sats uint))
  (begin
    (try! (contract-call? .dao check-is-protocol contract-caller))
    (var-set max-total-recycled sats)
    (print { event: "set-max-total-recycled", sats: sats })
    (ok true)
  )
)

(define-public (set-min-sweep-interval (blocks uint))
  (begin
    (try! (contract-call? .dao check-is-protocol contract-caller))
    (var-set min-sweep-interval blocks)
    (print { event: "set-min-sweep-interval", blocks: blocks })
    (ok true)
  )
)

(define-public (set-keeper (new-keeper principal))
  (begin
    (try! (contract-call? .dao check-is-protocol contract-caller))
    (var-set keeper new-keeper)
    (print { action: "set-keeper", data: { keeper: new-keeper, block-height: stacks-block-height } })
    (ok true)
  )
)
